claims.evidence: Witness photos show an Xbox console with an Xbox marking/logo, but do not show the exact model/version (One S vs others) or the storage size (1TB).
Photo 0 shows a black controller placed on top of the console; buttons and thumbsticks are visible.
No photo shows the console dashboard/library or installed game list.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Photos do not show seals, internal access, or repair/opening indicators.
Photos cannot confirm temperature, fan behavior, or overheating history.
No photo/video shows port testing (HDMI, USB, power, network) or device connectivity checks.
Photos show a controller, but do not show what 'pads' refers to (e.g., controller accessories) or whether originals are included.
No receipt or document is shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Wrong console model/version (e.g., not actually Xbox One S) which changes value
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker showing the exact model (e.g., 1540/1681/other) and/or the system settings screen that states 'Xbox One S'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unconfirmed Xbox One-era console (worst-case within what’s visible) with no guarantee of One S specifics.

risks.risk: Storage size not confirmed (1TB claim may be incorrect)
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity and free space.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest likely storage among comparable units until capacity is proven.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included items: power lead, HDMI cable, controller charging/battery setup, and any game discs/cases if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no guaranteed cables/accessories).

risks.risk: Controller issues (stick drift, non-responsive buttons, battery/charging problems)
risks.proof: A short video showing controller connected and working: thumbstick movement in a test screen, button presses registering, and charging/battery level shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price with controller assumed potentially needing service (worst-case) until responsiveness/charging is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Console functionality not proven (disc drive status, fan noise, stability, overheating behavior)
risks.proof: A video clip of the console booting to dashboard plus a quick test: fan/audio check during gameplay/menu navigation; if disc drive exists, show a disc being read/ejected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested for full functionality' and treat as not guaranteed working beyond visual identification.

risks.risk: Account/console restrictions (account-banned, not reset properly, login issues)
risks.proof: A photo/video of the console at the 'Reset/Ready to set up' screen or a successful sign-in to the dashboard without errors (hide personal info).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher risk of account issues until reset/ban status is shown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (showing exact model) and serial number (you can blur part of it).
Screenshot/photo from Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity (to confirm 1TB).
Photo of everything included laid out (power cable, HDMI cable, controller batteries/charging method, any original accessories).
Short video of controller connected: thumbstick movement test + button responsiveness + battery/charging status.
Video of console booting to dashboard and a quick stability check (fan noise/temperature behavior); if disc drive is present, show a disc read/eject test.
Photo/video showing the console reset/setup state or successful dashboard access without account errors.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an Xbox console with a controller, but the key pricing drivers (exact model/version, storage size, included accessories, and functional status) are not verifiable from the provided shots. Missing these prevents a confident worst-case price.
